name: push_closed_side_blade
code:
def primitive(obj, target, p):
    if target is None:
        return
    tx = target['center'][0]
    ty = target['center'][1]
    cx = obj['center'][0]
    cy = obj['center'][1]
    w = obj['width']
    close_gripper()
    for i in range(7):
        s = look()
        if s:
            if 'center' in s:
                cx = s['center'][0]
                cy = s['center'][1]
            if 'width' in s:
                w = s['width']
            if 'extent_major' in s:
                if s['extent_major'] > w:
                    w = s['extent_major']
            if 'extent_minor' in s:
                if s['extent_minor'] > w:
                    w = s['extent_minor']
        dx = tx - cx
        dy = ty - cy
        dist = hypot(dx, dy)
        if dist < p['goal_tol']:
            break
        ux = dx / dist
        uy = dy / dist
        rad = w * 0.5
        back = p['back_off']
        drv = p['drive_dist']
        if drv > dist:
            drv = dist
        sx = cx - ux * (rad + back)
        sy = cy - uy * (rad + back)
        ex = sx + ux * (back + drv)
        ey = sy + uy * (back + drv)
        yaw = atan2(uy, ux) + p['yaw_off']
        tilt = p['tilt']
        pz = p['push_z']
        lz = p['lift_z']
        ts = p['travel_speed']
        ps = p['push_speed']
        move(sx, sy, lz, yaw=yaw, tilt=tilt, speed=ts)
        move(sx, sy, pz, yaw=yaw, tilt=tilt, speed=ts)
        move(ex, ey, pz, yaw=yaw, tilt=tilt, speed=ps)
        move(ex, ey, lz, yaw=yaw, tilt=tilt, speed=ts)
    retreat(0.08)
description: Closes the gripper and pushes with the side of the closed finger pair yawed ~90deg to travel with slight tilt, in short look-driven shoves; single narrow side-blade contact herds the plate instead of the open two-point fork.
check: plate center within goal_tol (~0.025m) of zone center in perception

push_z.meaning: tool height during push to hit thin plate edge

lift_z.meaning: travel height when moving to start and lifting after push

back_off.meaning: gap behind plate edge where push starts

drive_dist.meaning: max forward drive through plate per shove

travel_speed.meaning: speed for air moves to start and lift

goal_tol.meaning: stop when plate center within this of target

yaw_off.meaning: hand yaw offset from push direction, ~90deg for side-blade push

tilt.meaning: lean about hand x to lower side edge contact

lineage.description: move an object along the table to a target location without grasping it (the object cannot be grasped: no grasp in the library fits it)
